name: Persist Claude Code login
description: Persists Claude Code's login (~/.claude, incl. the OAuth token in .credentials.json, AND ~/.claude.json which is symlinked into the volume since it lives outside ~/.claude) in a named Docker volume that outlives container stop/start and rebuilds. Pre-seeds the mount target owned by the remote user at build time so Docker's volume seeding gives the fresh volume correct ownership (no runtime chown / sudo needed).
